name: esp_lcd_axs15231b
description: Espressif AXS15231B esp_lcd panel driver (QSPI/SPI display), vendored from esp-iot-solution (Apache-2.0). The MIPI-DSI variant and the I2C touch driver are omitted (arduino-esp32 doesn't bundle the esp_lcd_touch component; this board's touch is hand-rolled in GuitionDisplay.h). Used by the esp32-guition envs. See license.txt.
